project.title: In-Store AV Demo Zone and Accessory Upsell Program
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardised in-store audio/video demo zone and accessory upsell routine to increase conversion and basket size while keeping operations efficient.
deliverables: Standard layout and equipment list for AV demo zone
Customer demo and upsell conversation script
Accessory bundle catalogue with pricing suggestions
Daily demo zone maintenance and cleanliness checklist
Simple sales tracking sheet for demo-driven sales
Display materials and fabric elements for demo area
constraints: Demo zone must fit within existing store footprint and fixtures
Only currently stocked products and accessories can be promoted
Setup and daily maintenance must fit within existing staffing levels
All materials must comply with store safety and visual guidelines
Project must be ready for pilot in 21 days
No permanent changes to building infrastructure allowed
stakeholders: Audio and video equipment specialised seller

risks.risk: Demo zone becomes cluttered or poorly maintained, reducing customer interest.
risks.mitigation: Introduce a clear daily checklist and assign ownership per shift with quick spot checks.

risks.risk: Staff do not consistently use the upsell script or accessory bundles.
risks.mitigation: Run short role-play sessions, keep scripts at the counter, and track usage feedback in the first weeks.

risks.risk: Selected demo products go out of stock, leaving the zone incomplete.
risks.mitigation: Coordinate with stock monitoring, define backup products, and include stock checks in daily routine.

risks.risk: Display materials or fabrics interfere with ventilation or safety requirements.
risks.mitigation: Have designs reviewed by health and safety officer and use only approved materials and placements.

themes.theme: Demo zone layout and equipment selection
themes.why_relevant: Drives which products are showcased and how customers experience sound and picture quality.
Ensures staff follow a consistent approach to identify needs and propose accessories and bundles.
Keeps the demo area functional, safe, and visually appealing throughout the day.
Avoids empty displays and ensures promoted items are actually available for sale.
Creates a clear, attractive zone using simple, low-cost visual elements and textiles.

backlog.task: Map current store space and propose location and size for the AV demo zone
backlog.owner_role: audio and video equipment specialised seller
definition_of_done: Simple sketch of current floor with proposed demo zone marked
Notes on power outlets, noise impact, and customer flow
Store manager has confirmed feasibility of proposed location

backlog.task: Select core audio and video products to feature in the demo zone
backlog.owner_role: audio and video equipment specialised seller
definition_of_done: List of 4–6 key demo products with model identifiers
Each product checked for current stock and near-term availability
Backup product list defined for each main item

backlog.task: Define accessory bundles linked to each demo product
backlog.owner_role: audio and video equipment specialised seller
definition_of_done: For each demo product, at least two accessory bundles defined
Bundles include cables, mounts, protection, or cleaning kits where relevant
Indicative bundle pricing or discount logic documented

backlog.task: Draft standard customer demo and upsell conversation script
backlog.owner_role: audio and video equipment specialised seller
definition_of_done: Script covers greeting, needs assessment, demo steps, and accessory upsell
Includes 3–5 open questions to identify customer needs
Script reviewed and adjusted after feedback from at least two colleagues

backlog.task: Create daily demo zone maintenance and cleanliness checklist
backlog.owner_role: audio and video equipment specialised seller
definition_of_done: Checklist covers power-on tests, cable management, dusting, and screen cleaning
Includes stock and price label checks for all demo items
Checklist fits into a 10–15 minute routine per shift

backlog.task: Design simple fabric-based backdrops and covers for the demo zone
definition_of_done: Measurements taken from proposed demo zone layout
2–3 fabric backdrop and cover concepts sketched
Materials list prepared with durable, easy-to-clean fabrics

backlog.task: Produce and test prototype fabric backdrops and equipment covers
definition_of_done: At least one full set of backdrops and covers sewn
Fabrics tested on-site for fit, safety, and ease of use
Feedback from sellers collected and minor adjustments noted

backlog.task: Prepare visual signage and price labels for demo products and bundles
backlog.owner_role: audio and video equipment specialised seller
definition_of_done: Signage text drafted for each demo product and bundle
Price labels aligned with current system pricing
Signs printed or requested according to store process

backlog.task: Set up pilot demo zone in-store and document final layout
backlog.owner_role: audio and video equipment specialised seller
definition_of_done: Demo zone fully assembled with products, fabrics, and signage
Photos taken from multiple angles and stored in shared folder
Any issues with power, sound levels, or safety documented

backlog.task: Create simple tracking sheet for demo-driven sales and accessory attach rate
backlog.owner_role: audio and video equipment specialised seller
definition_of_done: Columns defined for date, product, accessories sold, and notes
Sheet tested by logging at least one day of sample data
Instructions for use shared with all sellers

backlog.task: Run short internal training on demo script and daily routine
backlog.owner_role: audio and video equipment specialised seller
definition_of_done: 15–30 minute session agenda prepared
At least three colleagues attend or review materials
Questions and improvement suggestions captured

backlog.task: Collect first week feedback and propose adjustments to the setup
backlog.owner_role: audio and video equipment specialised seller
definition_of_done: Feedback gathered from staff and at least five customers
Key issues and quick wins summarised in a short note
List of 3–5 concrete adjustments proposed

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on demo zone location, layout, and core products to feature.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select final in-store location and approximate size for the demo zone.
Approve the initial list of core demo products and backup options.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define accessory bundles and the standard customer demo and upsell script.
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing first draft of bundles and asking for feedback on the conversation flow.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which accessory bundles will be promoted with each demo product.
Sign off on the final version of the demo and upsell script for training.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on daily maintenance routine, responsibilities, and tracking approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Post sharing the draft checklist and sales tracking sheet for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final daily maintenance checklist and who owns it per shift.
Decide how and when the demo-driven sales tracking sheet will be updated.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and validate fabric backdrops and covers for the demo zone.
threads_plan.trigger: Message from the sewing machinist sharing initial fabric concepts and measurements.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Choose the preferred fabric design and color scheme for the demo zone.
Approve the final fabric specifications after on-site safety and fit checks.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate pilot setup, training, and first-week adjustments.
threads_plan.trigger: Announcement that all materials are ready and scheduling the pilot setup date.
